name: Draft and run Scholar searches on a cross-citation query
route: POST /api/cross-citations/queries/{query_id}/search-plan → POST …/runs {searches[{key, url, q, practice}]} → GET /api/scholar/url-works?url=&query_id=&run_id=&item_key= per search
cost_note: one advanced LLM call to draft; per search 2 Scholar probes + 1 cheap relevance judge; evidence posted to /v1/practices
side_effects: run + item rows, search history, practice evidence
gated_by: an accepted focus statement on the query
yields: works with relevance verdicts, ticks, the next batch's review
